title: Introducing GPT-6.1 Terra
author: OpenAI
facts: Vendor release; API available; USD 1/M input, 0.05/M cached input, 5/M output; vendor benchmark claims, not independent measurements. Date corroborated by official Model Release Notes.

title: Model Release Notes
author: OpenAI
facts: Terra dated October 26, 2026; available in Work/Codex/API; API billed separately from subscriptions.

title: Computer use
author: OpenAI
facts: Action/screenshot loop requires actual execution and verification, bounded runs and scoped authority. API response completion is not proof that actions executed.

title: Working with academic communities to build scientific understanding
author: OpenAI
facts: Raw research data and external examination; ETH natural-language result Oct16, Lean Oct17. Practical algorithms require additional research. Physics artifacts withheld at stewards request.

title: Mathematical manuscripts and supporting proof artifacts
author: OpenAI
facts: Produced by unnamed internal model; results have varying verification status; ~42% top-line results formalized. Unformalized results may contain issues.

title: OpenAI math release history
author: OpenAI
facts: Oct26 additions include ETH and local smoothing. Oct7 withdrew three algebraic geometry papers and revised 14 papers; demonstrates need to preserve negative evidence.

title: Genie 4: A new generation of world simulation
author: Raia Hadsell and Diego Rivas and Hang Qi
facts: Trusted-tester research preview, broader access forthcoming. Visual/object permanence drift, physics/spatial/audio limitations remain. No access or quantitative physical simulator validation in campaign.

title: Claude Haiku 5.5
author: Anthropic
facts: Available small model for high-volume work and subagents; vendor reports ~75% lower average run cost than Haiku4.5. Not measured for this campaign.

title: Introducing Mistral Large 4
author: Mistral
facts: API public preview; weights promised by end of month, not established available here. 1T parameters/52B active per vendor.

title: Accelerating the search for antimicrobial peptides with Google Antigravity
author: Pengfei Tian and others
facts: Agentic database/structure workflow; candidate still undergoing wet-lab validation. Evidence for cheaper hypothesis workflow, not validated antimicrobial efficacy.

title: Exact sampling and counting for fixed-margin matrices
author: Jeffrey W. Miller and Matthew T. Harrison
facts: Exact dynamic programming counts and uniform samples via repeated-column-sum symmetries; no novel general sampling claim justified by a new implementation. Existing ecological, social-network, neurophysiology, psychometric applications.

title: EXACT version 0.3
author: Jeffrey W. Miller
facts: Free published C implementation with Python/R/Matlab wrappers, pure Python binary variant; warns memory-intensive and moderate-size/sparse limitations. Direct comparator, not generic unspecialized enumeration.

title: SAT-sampling for statistical significance testing in sparse contingency tables
author: Patrick Scharpfenecker and Tobias Windisch
facts: SAT fiber encoding handles structural zeros/bounds; hybrid MCMC methods. Authors report near-uniform SAT expensive even for small cases and CMSGen bias can distort p-value approximation. Methods are not general exact independent uniform samples.

title: SAT-Fiber walks source
author: Patrick Scharpfenecker and Tobias Windisch
facts: Public Apache2 source and benchmarks; conventional challenger available.

title: Linear-time uniform generation of random sparse contingency tables with specified marginals
author: Andrii Arman and Pu Gao and Nicholas Wormald
facts: Uniform generation expected linear in total M under max-margin condition Delta^4 < M/5; shows preexisting efficient specialized exact sampler.

title: Approximately Counting Integral Flows and Cell-Bounded Contingency Tables
author: Mary Cryan and Martin Dyer and Dana Randall
facts: FPRAS for arbitrary-margin/cell-bound tables with constant number of rows; DP plus volume estimation. Earlier bounded-table prior art.

title: scipy.stats.random_table
author: SciPy developers
facts: Conditional independence law using Boyett/Patefield, not uniform over integer tables; different scientific target. Fast baseline only for its intended distribution.

title: PopulationSim introduction
author: ActivitySim contributors
facts: Open platform from Oregon DOT need; individual travel-demand models need synthetic persons/households matching controls. Entropy balancing and LP integerization already available.

title: Population Synthesis with Quasirandom Integer Sampling
author: Andrew Smith and Robin Lovelace and Mark Birkin
facts: Open humanleague R package makes integer populations matching margins; discusses IPF integerization and empty-cell issues. Uniform-over-tables is not automatically population realism.

title: Mockaroo pricing
author: Mockaroo
facts: Official displayed USD60/year Silver, 500/year Gold, 7500/year private-cloud Enterprise. Adjacent synthetic-data anchor; no exact-fiber guarantee or direct willingness-to-pay evidence.

title: GraphPad Prism pricing
author: GraphPad
facts: Current opened page displays monthly Standard USD50 and Pro75; annual selectors are dynamic, so avoid stale search snippet corporate pricing. Adjacent scientific-software price, not exact-fiber willingness to pay.

title: An FPRAS for Cell-Bounded Contingency Tables
author: OpenAI
facts: New preprint allows arbitrary binary margins/cell bounds incl structural zeros; explicitly says polynomial bounds are generous and not practical runtime estimates. No implemented speedup may be inferred.

title: Sampling and counting contingency tables with arbitrary margins: formalization scope
author: OpenAI
facts: Exact sampling theorem is unbounded-cell tables; separate cell-bound theorem is approximate counting. Do not merge them into an unimplemented exact arbitrary-bounded polynomial sampler claim.
